parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm md md1 level 6.command: set protocols cfm md md1 level 6
set protocols cfm md md1 level 6.explanation: 配置CFM（Connectivity Fault Management）的维护域（MD）级别。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 in.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4] direction [parameter5]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 in.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 interface ge-0/0/1 direction outward
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 in.explanation: 配置CFM的维护端点（MEP）及其方向。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 cc.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ccm-send [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 cc.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 ccm-send enable
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 cc.explanation: 启用CFM的维护端点的CCM（Continuity Check Message）发送功能。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-m.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] ccm-receive [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-m.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-mep 1 ccm-receive enable
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-m.explanation: 启用CFM的远程维护端点的CCM接收功能。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode trunk
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换模式为trunk。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan10
